title: Actor Prakash Raj addresses youth protest demanding CEC removal in Thiruvananthapuram

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and demanded the removal of the CEC.
tea.want: Protesters are demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the stoppage of the Special Intensive Revision.
tea.changed: Oct 16: Actor Prakash Raj addressed a youth protest gathering at Manaveeyam Veedhi in Thiruvananthapuram following a police microphone intervention.

summary: Actor and social activist Prakash Raj addressed a youth gathering at Manaveeyam Veedhi in Thiruvananthapuram on Friday, October 16, 2026. Organised by the Collective for Democracy, the protest event called for the stoppage of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and demanded the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Before the meeting commenced, police intervened over the lack of microphone permission, causing a brief confrontation and minor tussle before authorities allowed the gathering to proceed. Speakers urged youth to maintain peaceful resistance despite restrictions and alleged suppression.
demands: Remove Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Stop the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
response: Police intervened before the meeting began over a lack of microphone permission, leading to a brief confrontation and minor tussle before allowing the event to continue, according to reports.
